basic_profile.bio: I'm a gaming enthusiast and reptile lover from Austin, Texas. During the day, I work as a software developer, and at night, you can usually find me gaming or caring for my leopard geckos. I enjoy unraveling the mysteries of video games like Red Dead Redemption and sharing tips with the community. I'm currently single and enjoy spending free weekends exploring new hiking trails. I typically browse Reddit during lunch breaks and late evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas, I have a strong foundation in technology and coding. I've self-taught myself various programming languages and enjoy creating gaming mods in my free time. My interest in reptiles started as a child, and I've since become quite knowledgeable about their care through personal research and community engagement.
